blockers.finding: NVS initialization errors NO_FREE_PAGES/NEW_VERSION_FOUND trigger whole-partition erase in the linked upstream path.
blockers.required: Extension must fail closed without erasing original NVS; validate both failures and recovery. Explicit factory reset must not be used as recovery.

blockers.finding: Candidate ELF links weak default auth and handshake functions. No demonstrated production-compatible authentication for App/account, BLE and avatar connections.
blockers.required: Obtain a supported upstream authentication/build route or explicitly redesign to retain the original binary for original mode. Existing NVS and a matching server address alone do not prove compatibility. Do not extract production secrets or substitute a captured token.

blockers.finding: Pending assets download can overwrite the shared assets partition. Generated assets differ from the device snapshot.
blockers.required: Do not install generated assets. Disable automatic shared-asset replacement in the extension and prove original model/font loading before accepting the image.

blockers.finding: Upstream can mark an image valid after 20 seconds, after version check, or before setup reboot, without validating voice and App operation.
blockers.required: Separate boot trial confirmation from ordinary startup. No automatic rollback promise based on these paths; retain USB rescue and verify deployed bootloader behavior.

blockers.finding: Original startup checks can update mqtt/websocket configuration; other official update paths may overwrite the retained original app slot.
blockers.required: Audit all update/configuration writers. Restrict the first trial to a reviewed service route, block updates that overwrite the rescue slot, compare original namespaces and validate credential refresh behavior.
